methodology.notes: In-situ higher-order harness: the tau2-eval plugin runs the eval loop INSIDE a live Claude Code session (agent-under-test = the session + legal-harness plugin; a Stop hook plays the tau2 user simulator). User simulator = claude_cli backend (claude -p on the subscription, NOT the canonical/MLX sim). Agent base model = the claude CLI default (unpinned), NOT the Sonnet 4.5 of the legal-harness submission, so this is NOT apples-to-apples with that 12/12 run. Single trial; scored by the canonical tau2 evaluator: 9/12 passing. See harnesses/docs/legal-insitu-validation-2026-06-17.md for the per-task diagnosis.
